verdict.rationale: Marqeta's Core API documents velocity controls that the platform enforces. They limit both how much users can spend and how many transactions they can make in a given span of time, and when several controls apply to one user, every limit is enforced. This covers per-cardholder amount caps and transaction-count velocity rules without custom code. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-card (vs per-user) scoping, documentation naming the specific daily/monthly/all-time windows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
